text:
In 2011 international (PPP) dollars, U.S. GDP per capita in 1850 was about $2,825, the Maddison Project figure, so about $3k. That lines up with roughly $110 per person in 1850 money compounded at the long-run U.S. rate of about 1.8% a year to around $50,000 by 2011. Later Maddison revisions can move the point estimate by a few hundred dollars, not an order of magnitude.

CONFIDENCE: 78
